answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can take a job. The stake is returned only after the agent finishes the work and a peer verifies it. A real agent pays once and earns it back. An attacker who spins up a hundred copies of a raven agent must fund a hundred stakes, and each failed or fake job forfeits one. That turns sybil attacks from free into expensive. The zenith of the design is honest agents paying almost nothing over time, while fakes keep losing money. The stake pool, call it saffron, holds the funds in escrow until the work clears.
